newsitem.title: USA: UST Inc backs tobacco settlement.
newsitem.headline: UST Inc backs tobacco settlement.

text.p: UST Inc on Friday said it endorses the settlement agreement covering litigation between the tobacco industry and 40 U.S. states and called for ratification of the pact by Congress.
"The company believes that the public interest and the interest of all parties are best served by having an agreement passed into law as quickly as possible," the company said.
The industry and representative attorneys general from 40 states suing to recoup public funds spent treating tobacco-related illnesses agreed Friday to a sweeping, $368.5 billion settlement package.

The company, which makes smokeless tobacco products, said the agreement was subject to approval by its board of directors, and that it would not comment on the details of its financial commitments under the settlement until the White House completes its review and the agreement becomes law.

"In the interest of achieving this resolution, the company has agreed to support certain legislative and regulatory provisions that conflict with long-held beliefs and positions of the company, but is willing to accept and is committed to supporting these provisions in the interest of resolving these important issues," UST said in a statement.
The company said its concessions would allow its adult customers to continue to use its products while curtailing youth access.

"Clearly, the agreement places difficult demands on smokeless tobacco manufacturers as well as the entire tobacco industry. Nevertheless, the company believes that this plan is far more preferable than continuing the controversy of the last 40 years, a conflict which provided no positive outcome for anyone," UST said.
